classificationDefinitions.GAMEPLAY_CORE: Combat and rules mechanics including AC, HP, speed, attacks, damage, saves, spells, defenses, conditions, recharge, and uses.
classificationDefinitions.GAMEPLAY_DESCRIPTION: Rule-bearing descriptive structures such as entries, actions, traits, reactions, and spell text; inline markup is retained.
classificationDefinitions.PRESENTATION: Names, display identity, size, alignment, creature type, and descriptive presentation.
classificationDefinitions.SOURCE_METADATA: Source references, pages, import metadata, and likely 5eTools-specific fields; advisory only.
classificationDefinitions.UNKNOWN: No confident rule matched; manual review needed.

classificationRules.matching: Case-insensitive exact path segments; earlier categories take precedence in this order: SOURCE_METADATA, GAMEPLAY_CORE, GAMEPLAY_DESCRIPTION, PRESENTATION, UNKNOWN.
